overview.bottoms_tested: Tested on 2.7 years of these coins, 30 days later: the classic pattern (bullish divergence plus a tight base) averaged 5% down and rose only 32% of the time, worse than a random coin (up 44% of the time). Buying after the break above the base was worse still. Catching bottoms has no edge in this data.
